text:
jason_k: Hey team — I just redeemed the onboarding free-trial grant from the dashboard (code: FREESTART). UI shows it accepted but my account balance still reads 0. Account: acct_01H7X2ABCD. Can someone confirm credits actually landed?
maria_support: Thanks for reporting — sorry about that. Can you paste the exact message you see in the activity feed or a screenshot? Also approximate time you applied it?
jason_k: Screenshot attached (clicked apply at 14:23 UTC). Activity feed shows "Grant applied: FREESTART (1,000 credits)" but balance at top-right still 0. No email received.
maria_support: Got it. I'm going to check the billing ledger and the promo processing pipeline. One sec.
billing-bot: [automated] Promo grant event received: event_id=pge_8u9, promo_code=FREESTART, account=acct_01H7X2ABCD, status=QUEUED_FOR_POSTING, created_at=2024-10-03T14:23:12Z
maria_support: I can see the grant created but the ledger post job hasn't finished: looks like a short race where the UI updated before the ledger write completed. Can you confirm you didn't refresh immediately after applying?
jason_k: I did refresh once about 20s later. It's been ~2 mins now and still 0.
ella_billing: Jumping in from billing — we see the queued promo event. Sometimes our async poster hits a transient duplicate-detection check if a previous promo record exists with slightly different metadata. I'll force-post the credit once I get permission from the account owner to do a manual ledger adjustment. Do you confirm we can proceed?
jason_k: Yes please proceed, confirmed.
ella_billing: Thanks. Creating manual ledger entry now. Reason: customer-request/manual-promo-fix.
billing-bot: [automated] Manual credit applied: ledger_tx=ltx_72K, amount=100000 (represents 1,000 credits),posted_to=acct_01H7X2ABCD, new_display_balance=100000, posted_by=ella_billing, timestamp=2024-10-03T14:24:35Z
jason_k: I see the balance updated — thanks! Quick question: will these credits retroactively apply to the small usage I had earlier this morning, or only future tokens?
maria_support: They post as account balance so yes — they reduce the available billable balance and will be used for subsequent billing runs. If you had already been invoiced for earlier usage, we can apply an adjustment; tell us if you want that and we can route to billing ops.
jason_k: No invoice yet, all good. Thanks for the quick turnaround. Any idea how to avoid this in future?
ella_billing: Short answer: wait ~60s after applying promos before starting heavy calls. Long answer: this was a timing window between the UI confirm and the ledger batch poster; engineering has a small fix queued to surface a "posting pending" state in the dashboard.
maria_support: For troubleshooting next time you can hit the ledger debug endpoint:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/ledger?account=acct_01H7X2ABCD
```
It will show pending events. If you want, I can leave the ticket open for a week to monitor.
jason_k: Please leave it open for a day. Appreciate the help :thumbsup:
maria_support: Ticket TKT-4582 created and assigned to billing ops for visibility. Closing here but we'll reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
